parsed.main_gap: Lemma 1 invokes a false infinite sunflower statement, though the bounded-cardinality version actually needed is valid and repairs the proof directly.

errors.description: Not every infinite family of distinct finite sets has an infinite sunflower; for example, the strictly increasing initial segments of the positive integers do not. The proof only needs this for sets of size at most K, where the infinite sunflower lemma is valid by induction on K, so replacing Lemma 1 by its bounded-size conclusion fixes the argument.
